directions: From Kilkenny O'Loughlin Gaels pull out of Lakeview Court and take the next right at the end of the road onto Hebron Road.
Continue up to the roundabout and take the 1st exit left onto Lintown Avenue.
Stay on Lintown Avenue for roughly half a kilometre until you reach the next roundabout.
At this roundabout take the 1st exit left onto Johnswell Road and follow it for about 350 metres.
